title: Jets trade Jermaine Johnson to the Titans for T’Vondre Sweat

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets trade Jermaine Johnson to the Titans for T’Vondre Sweat
sources.description: The Jets have traded defensive end Jermaine Johnson to the Tennessee Titans for defensive tackle T’Vondre Sweat. The story was broken by ESPN’s Adam Schefter. I’m sure this move won’t be popular among large portions of the Jets fanbase, but I think it’s a good one. Johnson has had one good season out of four […]
